paragraphs.text: Raises a Windows desktop notification card when DSH asks you a question, and returns to the asking S
ession when the card is clicked.
# dsh-message-reminder
A plugin for DSH (DeepSeek Harness). When DSH asks you a question with `ask_user_question` while you
are looking at something else, it raises a real acrylic notification card in the bottom-right corne
r of your Windows desktop. Clicking the card restores and raises the DSH window and navigates back t
o the Session that asked.
- Draws a borderless, always-on-top **acrylic** window (`SetWindowCompositionAttribute` + `DWMWA_WIN
DOW_CORNER_PREFERENCE`, painted with `TextRenderer.DrawText`), because the renderer `Notification` A

PI, `NotifyIcon` balloons and WinRT toasts all failed to show a banner in this Electron shell.
- **N
ever steals focus**, and the Session itself is untouched: the plugin only observes the `user-questio

ns/request` waterfall (`{ prepend: true }`) and passes the answer back to the original listener.
- S
tays quiet while the question card is already in front of you — the page reports "which Session is i

n the main view, is it visible, does it have focus" to the host.
- Host half uses Node built-ins onl
y (`node:child_process`, `node:fs`, `node:path`) and registers a `webServer` route, so there are no

runtime npm dependencies.
- Diagnostics: `GET /message-reminder/status`.
## Screenshot
A real card raised by `ask_user_question` while you are looking at something else: the title comes f
rom the plugin config, the body is the question summary, and clicking anywhere on the card restores
the DSH window and returns to the asking Session.
## Requirements

- DSH (DeepSeek Harness) with the Web client.
- Node.js >= 22.
- Windows 10 1803+ for the acrylic ca
rd. On macOS/Linux, or when PowerShell is unavailable, the host falls back to an in-page `Notificati
On macOS/Linux, or when PowerShell is unavailable, the host falls back to an in-page `Notification`.

kage name also appears in that profile's bundle list:

## Configuration
Override by row id in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (a `config` block replaces the whole default
block, so repeat every field you want to keep):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`notifyMode: balloon` is the historical name of the helper-process card channel; `renderer` forces t
he page's own notification and is the easiest way to test without spawning a child process. The soun
d plays when the card is actually shown, so it never "beeps without a card".

## Known limitations

- The card only exists on Windows; every other platform uses the renderer notification.
- The blur n
eeds `SetWindowCompositionAttribute` acrylic (Windows 10 1803+). If the system rejects the call the

card degrades to a solid background and everything else still works.
- Some AMSI providers occasiona
lly crash while PowerShell compiles the script; the host retries immediately (up to 5 times, ~0.1 s

per failure) before falling back to the renderer notification.
- The card body is truncated at 160 c

haracters; an over-long title is ellipsized.
- The first card is slightly slower than the rest (~1 s
) because the helper compiles a small Win32 helper at startup.

## 消息提醒 (Message Reminder)
DSH 调用 `ask_user_question` 询问用户时，在屏幕右下角弹出一张通知卡片；点击卡片会把 DSH 窗口恢复并置顶，同时自动回到发起询问的那个会话。
### 效果
标题取自插件配置（默认「DSH 消息提醒」），正文是问题摘要（超过 160 字符截断）；点击卡片任意位置即可回到发起询问的会话，点右上角 ✕ 只关掉卡片。
### 行为
| 时机 | 行为 |
| DSH 调用 `ask_user_question`，且页面**不在**该会话（或窗口已最小化） | 在工作区右下角（内缩 18px）弹出毛玻璃卡片并播放提示音，标题默认 `DSH 消息提醒`，正

文为问题摘要（多个问题时附带「共 N 个问题」），底部提示「点击卡片返回对话」 |
| DSH 调用 `ask_user_question`，但页面正显示该会话**且窗口是当前活动窗口** | **不

弹卡片、不响**：问题卡片已经在用户眼前的输入区里 |
| 点击卡片 | 把窗口恢复并置顶，然后把页面导航回发起询问的会话并展开待回答的问题卡片 |
| 点击右上角 ✕ | 忽略这条通知：卡片关闭，不

置顶、不跳转；询问仍在原地等待回答 |
| 弹出 / 关闭 | 从屏幕右边缘**滑入**（约 260ms，ease-out-back，过冲约 20px 后回弹到位）；点击或 ✕ 后向左滑出关闭（约 1

50ms） |
| 问题被回答 / 被取消 | 卡片随辅助进程一起消失 |
会话本身与询问流程完全不受影响：插件只是观察 `user-questions/request`，并把决定继续交给原来的应答者。卡片不会抢焦点，鼠标悬停时描边变亮、✕ 出现底衬。
滑动只改窗口位置（15ms 一帧的 `Timer` 插值），**刻意不用透明度淡入**：淡入需要分层窗口，会和 DWM 合成的 acrylic 毛玻璃打架。实测轨迹（1920 屏幕）：
[代码示例省略，未执行]
「忽略」只是让辅助进程以退出码 `0` 结束（点击是 `42`），Host 会把这次结束归类为「已被忽略的气泡」，因此既不重试也不回退到渲染进程通知；下一次询问照常弹出。
### 已知限制

- 卡片只存在于 Windows；其他平台走渲染进程通知。
- 毛玻璃依赖 `SetWindowCompositionAttribute` 的 acrylic（Win10 1803+），系统若拒绝该调

用，卡片会退化为纯色背景，其余行为不变。
- 本机的 AMSI 提供程序偶尔会在 PowerShell 编译脚本时崩溃，辅助进程会因此来不及显示卡片就退出；Host 会立刻重试（最多 5 次，每次失败

仅耗时约 0.1 秒），全都失败才回退到渲染进程通知。
- 卡片正文截断在 160 字符，标题过长时自动省略号。
- 辅助脚本启动时需编译一小段 Win32 帮助代码，首次弹出比后续略慢（约 1 秒）
